terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.section1Body: Media Roulette is a casual party game. It randomly selects photos and videos from the devices of players in a room and shows them to everyone so they can guess who took them.
terms.section2Body: You are fully responsible for the media stored on your device and for what you choose to show in the game. Do not use content that is illegal, offensive, harmful, or that you do not have the right to share.
terms.section3Body: Only the photos and videos played in a game are shared, after you have seen the selection. They are resized and re-encoded on your phone first, which removes location and camera metadata, and encrypted end to end. The game server keeps them only while your game runs and they are deleted when the game ends, when you leave, after 15 minutes of inactivity, or after 3 hours at most.
terms.section4Body: Multiplayer games use an online connection to sync players, scores and game state. Do not attempt to cheat, disrupt games, or attack the service or other players.
terms.section5Body: Media Roulette is provided “as is” without any guarantees. Use it at your own risk. The developer cannot be held liable for any loss, damage or issues arising from the use of the app.
terms.disclaimer: This text is a general description and may not cover all legal requirements in your country. For full legal compliance, please have it reviewed by a qualified lawyer.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Body: The app reads your photo and video library only to pick random media for the game, and only after you allow it. You see the selection first and can swap or remove anything. Only the items actually played in the game ever leave your phone: they are resized and re-encoded on your device first, which removes location and camera metadata. In Time Machine games, the year each photo was taken is also shared, and only revealed after the round.
privacy.section2Body: The game server keeps only what a game needs while it runs: the room PIN, usernames, answers and scores. There are no accounts, we do not build advertising profiles, and we do not sell your data.
privacy.section3Body: During a game, your username, answers, captions and scores are shared with the other players in the same room, along with the media played. Media is stored temporarily on the game server and deleted when the game ends, when you leave, after 15 minutes of inactivity, and in any case after 3 hours. Phones delete downloaded media at the end of the game.
privacy.section4Body: You can revoke photo and video permissions at any time in your device settings. In the app settings you can also exclude specific albums so they are never used in the game.
privacy.section5Body: Media is end-to-end encrypted: it is encrypted on your phone with a key shared only between the players' phones, so the game server stores and relays files it cannot read. Connections to the server are encrypted too.
privacy.disclaimer: This policy is a simplified explanation of how the app handles data and may not cover all legal requirements in your country. For full legal compliance, please have it reviewed by a qualified lawyer.
